title: Eleven Steps and One Pause
subtitle: 舞蹈韵律 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 舞蹈韵律（文学艺术与体育·舞蹈与韵律）
meta: 主题语境：舞蹈韵律（文学艺术与体育·舞蹈与韵律）　|　核心词汇：step　|　正文 333 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 step 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My grandmother taught dancing for thirty-one years in a room above a shop, eleven pupils at a time. The first thing she taught was not a ① step but a pause, and she said a ② step you cannot stop halfway through is not a step at all but a fall, and that most people spend their lives falling in time.

There were eleven ③ steps up to that room, stone and worn in the middle, and she counted them aloud every Thursday, which everybody thought was for the children and which I now think was for her. The ④ step at the top was the one she never counted, because it was the floor, and she said a floor is a step you have already taken. She never said that to a pupil, only to me, and I think it was the only thing she ever told me twice.

⑤ Step by step, she used to say, is not a way of going slowly but a way of knowing where you are, and I did not understand that for thirty-one years. She ⑥ took steps, as the council would have called it, exactly once, in 1974, when the roof went and she wrote to them eleven times.

The next ⑦ step, as my father called it, was retirement, which she refused for eleven years. She said retirement is a ⑧ step somebody else has named for you, and that she had no intention of taking it in 1989 or in any other year. She kept the room for eleven more years and taught eleven more pupils, and the council never wrote back.

She died in 1998, eleven years after she stopped teaching. She had been ⑨ out of step with the village for thirty-one years and never once minded. The last thing she said to me was that a ⑩ step is the smallest thing you can give somebody and the only one they can take away with them. I have never learned to dance, and she never once asked me to.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 一步；脚步；步子
B. n. 步骤；措施；下一步
E. 固定搭配：step by step 一步一步地
F. 固定搭配：take steps 采取措施；采取行动
G. 固定搭配：in / out of step (with) （与……）合拍／不合拍

items.q: was not a step but a pause
a step you cannot stop halfway through
There were eleven steps up to that room
The step at the top was the one she never counted
Step by step, she used to say
She took steps, as the council would have called it
The next step, as my father called it
retirement is a step somebody else has named
She had been out of step with the village
that a step is the smallest thing

answers.why: a step 意为“舞步”，她最先教的不是舞步，而是停顿。
a step 仍指“舞步”，一个中途停不下来的舞步不是舞步，而是摔倒。
steps 意为“台阶、梯级”，通往那间屋子有十一级石阶，中间已经磨凹。
the step 意为“一级台阶／一步”，最上面那一级她从不数，因为那已经是地板。
step by step 意为“一步一步地”，她说那不是走得慢，而是知道自己在哪儿。
take steps 意为“采取措施、采取行动”，她只采取过一次，就是 1974 年屋顶坏的时候。
the next step 意为“下一步、下一个步骤”，我父亲说的下一步是退休。
a step 意为“阶段、进程”，她说退休是别人替你命名的那一个阶段。
out of step with ... 意为“与……不合拍、不一致”，她三十一年都与这个村子不合拍。
a step 意为“一步”，她说一步是你能给别人的最小的东西，也是唯一能带走的东西。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 她最先教的不是舞步，而是一个停顿。（step）
通往那间屋子有十一级石阶，中间已经磨凹了。（steps）
她说，一步一步来不是走得慢，而是知道自己在哪儿。（step by step）
她只采取过一次行动，是在 1974 年屋顶坏掉的时候。（take steps）
下一步，用我父亲的话说，就是退休。（the next step）
她三十一年都与这个村子不合拍，却从不在意。（out of step with）

There were eleven steps up to that room, stone and worn in the middle.
Step by step, she said, is not a way of going slowly but a way of knowing where you are.
She took steps exactly once, in 1974, when the roof went.
The next step, as my father called it, was retirement.
She had been out of step with the village for thirty-one years and never once minded.
